tvShow.name: The Marlow Murder Club
tvShow.overview: Retired archaeologist and crossword setter Judith Potts believes that a brutal murder has taken place in the sleepy town of Marlow; when the police refuse to believe her story, she kicks off a private investigation with two unlikely friends.

episodes.name: The Marlow Murder Club (1)
episodes.overview: Judith Potts's peaceful evening in Marlow is shattered when she witnesses the murder of her neighbour. With the local police, led by newly promoted DS Tanika Malik , reluctant to believe her story, Judith starts her own investigation.

episodes.name: The Marlow Murder Club (2)
episodes.overview: Judith, Becks and Suzie are officially brought in to help the police investigation. They uncover an important connection between the murders, but can they stop the killer before they strike again?

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Retired archaeologist Judith Potts lives alone in a faded mansion in the peaceful town of Marlow, filling her time by setting crosswords for the local paper. During one of her regular wild swims in the Thames, Judith hears a gunshot coming from a neighbour's garden and believes a brutal murder has taken place.

episodes.name: Death Comes to Marlow (1)
episodes.overview: A wealthy baronet dies alone in his study the day before his wedding and Judith, Becks and Suzie find themselves at the centre of another mystery.

episodes.name: Death Comes to Marlow (2)
episodes.overview: As the suspects' alibis stack up, Judith, Becks and Suzie are pushed to their limits. Can they solve the murder before anyone else gets hurt?

episodes.name: Death on the Close (1)
episodes.overview: When a man with no ID and no connection to Marlow is found dead in the middle of a suburban road, Judith, Becks and Suzie delve into secrets between the residents.

episodes.name: Death on the Close (2)
episodes.overview: A surprising link to a past missing persons case shines a new light on the residents of Linnet Close - but could they be responsible for murder on their doorstep?

episodes.name: Sailing Close to the Wind (1)
episodes.overview: After a revered member of the sailing club is brutally bludgeoned to death, Judith, Becks and Suzie navigate simmering grudges within the tight-knit community.

episodes.name: Sailing Close to the Wind (2)
episodes.overview: Motives stack up against the suspects, Kit's killer sends another violent warning and Judith, Becks and Suzie are in a race against time to solve the case.

episodes.name: The Queen of Poisons (1)
episodes.overview: When the Mayor dies in the middle of a meeting, Judith, Becks and Suzie uncover lies, scandal and blackmail.

episodes.name: The Queen of Poisons (2)
episodes.overview: As the suspects' secrets stack up, Judith, Becks and Suzie still can't find anyone with a motive to hurt the Mayor.

episodes.name: Murder in the Dark (1)
episodes.overview: When a man is killed at her university reunion, Becks finds herself on the wrong side of an investigation. Was a friend responsible or did someone break in?

episodes.name: Murder in the Dark (2)
episodes.overview: As Judith and Suzie work with the police to find the killer, tensions rise among Becks' friends in the house. Guest starring Harry Enfield.

episodes.name: An Appetite for Murder (1)
episodes.overview: When a popular but tempestuous celebrity chef is murdered during his cookbook launch, there's no shortage of suspects for Judith, Suzie and Becks.

episodes.name: An Appetite for Murder (2)
episodes.overview: As police investigate the chef's death, a new development makes them rethink everything they have learned so far. Guest starring Susan Lynch.
